author: Legoche
body:
Basically, Juanoh has always hated me and a lot of my teammates. I reported him on OCN for ban evasion and he got banned. Somehow he found out it was me and now he sent me these messages:

"What a fucking legend"
"You autoclick and report me at the same time for evasion"
"What a god, I'll try to expose you as soon as possible, prick"
(http://imgur.com/6Bs7OpN)

Then in the Instant Damage team chat (He doesn't know I am in) he put these messages:

"If I ever find anyway to do the same to him I'll do it for sure xd"
(http://imgur.com/Wc0GR73)


I do not think Avicus staff can do anything about this as it was outside Avicus, but just remember, this kid is out to expose me and I am very scurred ;oooooo

replies.body: Yes, but is demotion from Ref possible since he shows Avicus in a bad light?

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
As far as Im concerned No. The player in question has done nothing wrong on Avicus (as far as Im concerned). Therefore, he will not be demoted from Referee. Although I would contact an Official, and file a complaint.

Thanks for the report!
